title: Why a Whole Swedish City Is Being Moved (Even Its Church)
description:
In August 2025, a 672-tonne wooden church drove across the Swedish city of Kiruna at walking pace. Why? Because the iron ore mine under the city is making the ground unstable, and the whole city is being moved about three kilometers east. This is the story of the mine, the move, and what it costs.
